blocks.content:
• Controls Council of Ministers
• Has greater financial powers
• Can pass No-Confidence Motion
• Council is responsible to Assembly

rows: Council is not responsible to Legislative Council

items: A No-Confidence Motion can ONLY be introduced and passed in the Legislative Assembly, not the Legislative Council.
The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly, which is a frequent question in State PSC and UPSC exams.
In terms of financial matters, the Legislative Assembly holds ultimate authority over the Legislative Council.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Legislative Assembly exercises direct control over the Council of Ministers.
It possesses significantly greater financial powers compared to the Legislative Council.
The power to introduce and pass a No-Confidence Motion lies solely with the Legislative Assembly.
The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly.
